advisor_identified: Historian of modern Ireland at Concordia University's School of Irish Studies, cross-appointed in History; supervisor of the listed 2017 dissertation.

doctorate.title: The Social Structures and Cultural Politics of the Irish Civil War

evidence.says: The catalogue identifies Unsettled Island as a 2017 History PhD thesis at Concordia University and lists its supervisor as Foster, Gavin M.
Foster's faculty biography identifies him as professor of modern Irish history in the School of Irish Studies, cross-appointed in History, and explicitly states PhD, University of Notre Dame, 2009.

Notre Dame's Kellogg Institute independently lists Gavin Foster's PhD as University of Notre Dame, 2009, and associates him with a dissertation fellowship for The Social Structures and Cultural Politics of the Irish Civil War.

The commencement program, printed page 9, lists Gavin Maxwell Foster under doctoral recipients, with History as his major subject and The Social Structures and Cultural Politics of the Irish Civil War as his dissertation.

notes: The supervisor identity is confirmed by the exact student thesis. The linked AHA record matches Foster's documented institution, year, History field and dissertation title. The 2010 commencement program is used for the title; both the Concordia biography and Notre Dame alumni profile explicitly give the PhD year as 2009.
